periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation, sloping downward toward the rostrum at approximately a 45-degree angle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovaloid morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal axis ratio exceeding 1.2.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Substantial downward elongation where the lower pole of the patch is significantly further from the center than the upper pole.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shaped profile across the posterior boundary.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, representing approximately one-third of the visible dorsal-ventral torso span.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Large inter-pinna gap, approximately equal to the horizontal diameter of the pinna itself.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the superior margins.
